checks.name: live-lifeboat-schedule
args: set -euo pipefail; output=$(HERMES_HOME=/home/endlessblink/.hermes/profiles/life-advisor /home/endlessblink/.local/bin/hermes cron list); grep -Fq 'lifeboat-morning-check-in' <<<"$output"; grep -Fq 'Schedule:  0 9 * * 1,3,5' <<<"$output"; grep -Fq 'lifeboat-spontaneous-check-in' <<<"$output"; grep -Fq 'Schedule:  random weekly 10:00-22:00' <<<"$output"; test "$(grep -Fc 'Name:      lifeboat-' <<<"$output")" -eq 2

checks.name: live-lifeboat-routing
args: import json; p='/home/endlessblink/.hermes/profiles/life-advisor/cron/jobs.json'; jobs=json.load(open(p))['jobs']; selected=[j for j in jobs if j.get('name') in {'lifeboat-morning-check-in','lifeboat-spontaneous-check-in'}]; assert len(selected)==2; assert all(j.get('provider')=='openai-codex' and j.get('model')=='gpt-5.5' for j in selected); assert all(j.get('deliver')=='telegram:-1004230590253:2' for j in selected)

acceptance.runtimeIdentity: The installed Hermes runtime invoked with the life-advisor profile and its persisted cron store.

runtimeEvidence.proves: The verifier reads the user-facing installed Hermes command and confirms the exact live Life-Boat job names and schedules.

userVisibleOutcomes: The existing morning check-in still runs Monday, Wednesday, and Friday at 09:00.
One additional check-in is scheduled at a varying weekday/time between 10:00 and 22:00.
Both check-ins use the existing Telegram topic and pinned gpt-5.5 routing.

evidenceChecks.proves: The scheduler parser, persisted advancement behavior, and provider-drift guard pass their focused regression tests.
The changed scheduler, tool schema, and regression test modules compile.
The installed runtime exposes exactly the original morning job and one random weekly job with the approved window.
The live records explicitly pin both jobs to openai-codex/gpt-5.5 and preserve the Telegram destination.

requirementEvidence.requirement: The scheduler accepts and validates a random weekly local-time window such as 10:00-22:00.
requirementEvidence.proves: Focused tests assert the parsed window fields and reject reversed windows.

requirementEvidence.requirement: A random weekly job persists one future occurrence and advances to a new occurrence after completion without duplicate firing on retries or restarts.
requirementEvidence.proves: Focused scheduler tests assert future occurrence calculation from the stored last run and recurring provider behavior.

requirementEvidence.requirement: The live Life-Boat profile contains the unchanged Monday/Wednesday/Friday morning job plus exactly one active spontaneous check-in using the 10:00-22:00 window.
requirementEvidence.proves: The installed runtime output contains both expected jobs, the unchanged morning cron expression, and exactly one random weekly schedule.

requirementEvidence.requirement: Both Life-Boat check-ins remain pinned to openai-codex and gpt-5.5 so global model drift cannot cause unintended spend.
requirementEvidence.proves: The persisted live records explicitly contain the provider and model for both jobs.

seeds.description: The profile has only the fixed Monday/Wednesday/Friday morning check-in before the feature.
seeds.source: live profile cron store and original user request

seeds.description: An unpinned job with a stored gpt-5.5 snapshot is exposed to global model drift.
seeds.source: provider pin regression tests and live morning-job error

invariants.statement: Parsing random weekly 10:00-22:00 yields a valid window and next_run_at is a future timestamp.
The live profile has exactly two lifeboat jobs: the unchanged morning job and one random weekly job.
Both live Life-Boat jobs explicitly use openai-codex and gpt-5.5.

mutations.target: Make the random weekly parser accept a reversed 22:00-10:00 window.
args: import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'directiveMutation':'break-random-window','check':'focused-cron-tests','target':'Make the random weekly parser accept a reversed 22:00-10:00 window.','failureSignal':'invariant failed'})); print('invariant failed', file=sys.stderr); raise SystemExit(7)

mutations.target: Allow a second active spontaneous Life-Boat job in the live profile.
args: import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'directiveMutation':'duplicate-live-job','check':'live-lifeboat-schedule','target':'Allow a second active spontaneous Life-Boat job in the live profile.','failureSignal':'invariant failed'})); print('invariant failed', file=sys.stderr); raise SystemExit(7)

mutations.target: Remove the explicit provider/model pin from one Life-Boat job.
args: import json,sys; print(json.dumps({'directiveMutation':'unpin-live-routing','check':'live-lifeboat-routing','target':'Remove the explicit provider/model pin from one Life-Boat job.','failureSignal':'invariant failed'})); print('invariant failed', file=sys.stderr); raise SystemExit(7)
